copy.homeTitle: What I’m studying, building and breaking.
copy.homeBrand: I don’t take myself seriously, but I take my projects very seriously. I build useful things people actually use, and because they use them, I have to make them reliable.
copy.newWhat: The Lab is the bench behind the desk: what I study, build and test, written up with the working shown, including what didn’t work.
copy.newRead: Underlined words open a preview when you hover or tap them, so you can check a term without losing your place. Small raised numbers are references, listed at the end of each page.
copy.newStart: Pick a section below; each one says in a line what it holds. Every page carries the date it was written, and the date it last changed.
copy.cardInternal: Not published. The chapters are written from it.
copy.nextTitle: This page isn’t in the mockup yet.
copy.nextBody: This page belongs to the rest of the site, or to the next round of the mockup. Every page of the Lab itself is built.
copy.beginStudy: Begin with a study’s own page, such as [[{link}]]: it maps every topic and keeps the log, and its notes and series go deeper.
copy.beginSeries: Read a series in order, from its first chapter; [[{link}]] lists them.
copy.beginBuild: Each build opens with the thing working, then how it’s made. Any one is a fair start; [[{link}]] is the oldest.
copy.beginExperiment: Each experiment opens with its result, then the setup that produced it. [[{link}]] was the first.
copy.beginEssay: Essays stand alone, so start with whichever title pulls you in. [[{link}]] came first.
copy.beginNote: Notes are short; [[{link}]] is the first.
copy.beginChapter: Chapters read in order; [[{link}]] is the first one written.
copy.indexLede: All {n} of them, by date written, grouped by year. Show one kind at a time if you like.
copy.glossLede: Every dotted-underlined word in the Lab, with what it means here. The definitions are short on purpose; the pages that use them go further.
copy.boardLabel: Topics of the study, one square each, in rows by track
copy.boardKey: {done} done, {doing} under way, {rest} to go. A full square is done; a dashed edge is under way, filled as far as its hours have gone; faint is parked or later.
copy.boardIntro: Each square is one topic. Hover or tap one for its name and where it stands:
